name: jobhunt
description: Personal job-hunt assistant: discovers roles from ATS public APIs, alert emails and remote boards, scores them against `config/profile.yaml`, tracks every job in SQLite, and applies only after explicit approval. Claude Code skills (`/jobs-scan`, `/jobs-review`, `/jobs-apply`, `/jobs-sync`, `/jobs-refer`, `/jobs-status`) provide the judgement; `uv run jobhunt <cmd>` does the deterministic work.
